Option A galat hoga kyunki 'violated' past indefinite tense mein likha hai, option B bhi galat hoga kyunki 'was being violated' galat tense ka use kiya hai, option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'had been found' galat tense ka use kiya hai. diye gaye options mein se option C sahi hoga kyunki 'was found' ko 'found' mein change kar diya aur 'had been violated' ko passive mein hee chod diya. Baaki option mein tense ki galti hai lekin option C mein atleast 'was found' ko active mein change kiya aur 'had been violated' ko passive mein hee chod diya aur tense bhi sahi hai, isliye option C se kaam chalana padega. Better answer :- authorities found that someone had violated the agreement despite multiple warnings.

questions.question: Change passive to active. The claim that the system had been tampered with was dismissed as baseless.
options: The system tampered the claim, which was dismissed.
The dismissal of the system tampering was claimed.
It was dismissed as baseless that the system was tampered with.
Authorities dismissed the claim that someone had tampered with the system.
questions.solution: Sentence mein passive to active change karna hai, 'the claim' subject hai jiski verb 'was dismissed' hai aur 'that....se lekar.... With' tak adjectival clause 'claim' ke liye, isliye 'was dismissed' active mein 'dismissed' verb ki 2nd form mein change hoga aur 'had been tampered' active mein 'had tampered' mein change hoga, aur claim ko dismiss karne wala koi doer hoga, isliye active mein subject 'authorities' ho jayega, aur aisa sirf option D mein follow ho raha hai.

questions.question: Change passive to active. The possibility of the files being leaked before the official release was not ruled out.

The release happened before ruling out the leak possibility.
questions.solution: Sentence ko passive to active karna hai, isliye 'was not ruled out' aur 'being leaked' mein se ek bhi agar active mein ho jaaye toh sahi hoga kyunki isme best option nahi hai. option A, B aur D galat honge kyunki isme 'not' nahi hai jisse meaning he galat ho jayega. Option C sahi hoga kyunki 'was not ruled out' passive ko active mein 'did not rule' kar diya, toh option C mein kam se kam ek ko passive kar diya aur meaning bhi aisa koi galat nahi aa raha, isliye option C se kaam chal jayega. Best answer:- authorities/they/people did not rule out the possibility of someone leaking the files before the official release.

Option C se kaam chal jayega kyunki 'have been halted' perfect tense ko active mein 'have halted' mein change kar diya aur 'is alleged' ko 'are alleged' passive mein hee chod diya, agar ek verb bhi active mein change ho jaaye toh yeh structure bhi sahi hota hai. questions.question: Change passive to active. New protocols are expected to have been implemented by the end of the fiscal year.
options: Authorities implemented the protocols by the fiscal year-end.
The administration expects to implement protocols soon.
Authorities are expected to implement new protocols by fiscal year-end.

questions.solution: Sentence ko passive to active karna hai, isliye 'are expected' aur 'to have been implemented' mein se ek bhi agar active mein ho jaaye toh sahi hoga kyunki isme best option nahi hai. option A aur D galat hoga kyunki 'implemented', 'were implemented' dono mein past tense ka use hai joki galat hai. option B bhi galat hoga kyunki passive mein bataya ki 'fiscal year' ke end tak hoga lekin ismein 'soon' kar diya. 'expect' se pata chal raha ki future ki baat karni hai, agar 'to have implemented' hota tho behtar hota, lekin future ko dikhaane ke liye infinitive bhi use hota hai, isliye 'to implement' se bhi kaam chal jayega, isliye option C sahi hoga. Better answer:- 'people expect authorities to have implemented the new protocols by the end of the fiscal year'.
